author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: A two-scale 4L-node packet grid has uniform derivative valuations, integral shifted kernels and exact local Smith valuations 4j-2 popcount(j)+2(b-r) floor(j/d). A complete all-node recovery functional normalized by explicitly modeled spectral scales has exact optimum W/(w^T A^-1 K), with denominator below 10(r+t+2), independent of the numerical gap. A generic full-grid rational-polynomial witness gives an all-jet precision obstruction at these scales. A full mode algorithm, tensor realization of the stronger witness, and a SAT time improvement are not established.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the component proofs
Joint changed recovery precision and realizable crossing-mode factors with their multiplicities
Full inherited precision, child, entry, leaf and outer reduction cost before any bound claim
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent review claimed
